scripts.dev:cf: npm run build && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler dev --local
scripts.local:ai:debug: npm run db:migrate:local && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler dev --local --var GENERATION_MODE:simulation --var GENERATION_MAX_COST_MINOR:0 --var TEAM_DOMAIN:local.invalid --var POLICY_AUD:rigstage-local-test
scripts.local:ai:verify: npm run check && npm run test && npm run build && npm run cf:dry-run
scripts.build: npm run typegen && npm run check:types && vite build
scripts.check: npm run typegen:check && npm run check:types && eslint . && prettier --check .
scripts.check:types: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.worker-test.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:worker && npm run test:owner-onboarding
scripts.db:migrate:local: WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.deploy:ci: npm run prepare:deploy && npm run db:migrate:ci && wrangler deploy --config .wrangler/deploy.jsonc
